blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Wind signals may be raised in parts of Cagayan and Isabela starting Wednesday as Super Typhoon Champi approaches the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR), with its closest approach to Northern Luzon expected later this week, the state weather bureau said Monday. In its 5 p.m. public weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Champi was still outside PAR as of 3 p.m. Monday, located 1,525 kilometers east of southeastern Luzon. The super typhoon was packing maximum sustained winds of 185 kilometers per hour (kph) and gusts of up to 230 kph, moving west-northwestward […]...
